author: shuijikou
body:
“i don't care about pet or summoner builds”

Sad pet player sound.

Anyways, since you are a fresh 225, no need to rush on ascension, wait till you have all base classes,maybe 235 or 245 get most of their skills and by then you probably had a few decent gears, play with different classes for a few dungeons/raids/pvps, get to know them,then decide which to ascension.

unless of course,if you have a clear favor class,then ascension right away (for my case, i love pet class from the start,t7/t8dragon/t9bahamut/t10beo, so once i have the essential skills that i needed,i started ascension Beo)

author: [deleted]
body:
A less demanding PvP class is RealmShifter. Thanks for the most recent update he gets free turns, darn useful in PvP. 

I have all the classes unlocked, do most of my play as a summoner, but for PVP I always switch to RS / Charmer. 

With warriors pavane I typically do 15-25k damage on the first round, enough to kill soft targets like summoners in one shot. 

When you don't hit the summoner or are fighting something with high defense, you can potentially get a second turn and finish them off. 

When you get hit and survive, you're often low health and your evasion jumps through the roof. 

Seeing summoners that start with ward up ? No worries, RS absolutely wrecks wards. 

Not a great class for survival though, so I only use it to PvP
Basically I want to focus hard on ONE class for ascensions and I have trouble deciding which one to go with especially since idk much about the potential of the celestial classes
Currently been thinking about Heretic Ara, Heretic, Realmshifter and Gilgamesh all seem to be somewhat on the same level from what ive seen.
